subject: ready-for-life
standards: Ready for Life v1, Grade 4 Unit 3: Kitchen Care and Food Safety
instructions: Complete the task or its stated simulation alternative. Do not submit photos, recordings, addresses, account details, or private household information.
Learner completion never certifies a guardian-authority task; those tasks remain pending until a guardian attests.

learnerTasks.directions: Before touching any ingredient, wash your hands and clean your workspace.
learnerTasks.prompt: I washed my hands with soap for a full 20 seconds before touching any ingredient.

learnerTasks.directions: Before touching any ingredient, wash your hands and clean your workspace.
learnerTasks.prompt: I wiped down the plate, bowl, or counter space I will use before starting.

learnerTasks.directions: With your adult supervising, gather your ready-to-eat ingredients, check each one for freshness with your adult, and lay them out in the order you will use them.
learnerTasks.prompt: I checked with my adult that every ingredient was already washed, cooked, or pre-sliced and safe to use.

learnerTasks.directions: With your adult supervising, gather your ready-to-eat ingredients, check each one for freshness with your adult, and lay them out in the order you will use them.
learnerTasks.prompt: I laid out my ingredients in the order I planned to use them before starting to assemble.

learnerTasks.directions: Assemble your food item yourself, step by step, keeping ready-to-eat ingredients away from any surface or utensil that touched raw or unwashed food earlier in the day, then show your adult the finished result.
learnerTasks.prompt: Describe the order you assembled your item in, and name one moment where you made sure a surface or utensil was clean before it touched your ready-to-eat ingredients.

learnerTasks.directions: Assemble your food item yourself, step by step, keeping ready-to-eat ingredients away from any surface or utensil that touched raw or unwashed food earlier in the day, then show your adult the finished result.
learnerTasks.prompt: Looking back at your assembly, did you keep every ready-to-eat ingredient away from anything that had touched raw or unwashed food?

learnerTasks.directions: Compare making this item carefully to how food might get made without thinking about safety.
learnerTasks.prompt: Explain one specific food-safety step you did during this preparation that someone rushing without thinking might skip, and what could go wrong if they skipped it.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated Food-safety practice during assembly criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated Explanation of safety reasoning criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the assessed objective.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Kitchen Care and Food Safety?
